mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 100k) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates a rapidly tightening labor market that fuels wage inflation and prompts aggressive monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) exceeding 5.0% signals economic overheating that triggers fears of aggressive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 5.0% and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeds 100.0 (2017=100), it signals a sustained recovery in manufacturing output that supports economic growth and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600.0 thousand units, it signals robust consumer demand for housing that supports economic growth and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600.0 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 600000.0 million dollars, it signals a synchronized surge in consumer demand across major sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1600.0 and RSAFS > 600000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers long-term interest rates and boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.2% over the prior 90 days.
